Highlights:
## A NEED FOR SPEED

Optimized for the PCIe Gen5 interface, SPATIUM M580 SSD reaches read/write speeds up to 14,600/12,700 MB/s, allowing for rapid data transfer and shortened game load times.

### 14,600 MB/s

### 12,700 MB/s

*Disclaimer: Performance may vary based on system hardware & software configuration.

## PCIe 5.0

Get excited for next-generation storage performance that unites the latest PCIe Gen 5 controller technology and state-of-the-art 3D NAND flash, providing up to 2 times faster read/write speeds compared to the previous generation SSDs.

## LEAPS

The SPAITUM M580 delivers immense performance and capabilities that effortlessly handle even the most extreme gaming or productivity

...

PCIe 5.0 Up to 29x

...

## SMALL SIZE MORE STORAGE

The latest 3D NAND flash technology brings dense storage in a compact design and allows SPATIUM storage capacities up to 4TB.

### TOWERING PERFORMANCE

FROZR is a new enthusiast passive SPATIUM SSD thermal solution designed with well-pathed Core Pipes and an optimal surfaced heatsink under a stylish cover, silently sustaining maximum storage while reducing temperatures by up to 20° C

### TRIPLE CORE PIPES

Flattened surface for max contact with controller & flash modules for optimal heat transfer

### Well-Pathed Design

Efficiently spreading heat to the top and middle of the surfaced heatsink.

### Ascent Heatsink

Elevated aluminum fins allowing more airflow passthrough for quick heat dissipation.

*Disclaimer: Performance may vary based on system hardware & software configuration.

## FITS RIGHT IN

The FROZR Heatsink is designed for the standard M.2 size of 22 x 80mm which seamlessly accommodates most graphics card backplates, preventing interference in the gap between the SSD and graphics cards.

...

## SPATIUM M580 PCIe 5.0 NVMe M.2 FROZR

- PCIe Gen5x4 interface and complies with the NVMe NVMe 2.0 standard
- Enthusiast passive SSD thermal design silently reducing temperatures by up to 20° C
- Sequential Read speeds up to 14,600MB/s and Write speeds up to 12,700MB/s
- Up to 3000 TBW
- Built-in data security and error-correction capabilities
- 1TB to 4TB capacities in M.2 2280 form factor
- 5-Year Warranty
